source.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset — High Resolution

note: Approximate mapped river centerline, not a recommended navigation channel. Channels, hazards and conditions change. Does not enable GPS time remaining or replace planning mileage.

review.reviewer: Float ETA desktop agency, imagery and downstream-network review
review.note: CPW identifies South Beach to Duffy Mountain as a 32-mile segment. The visible river and agency network agree; clouds partly obscure one portion of the overview imagery. The agency’s low-water advisory remains visible. Geometry, endpoint and mileage checks pass. This review does not enable GPS ETA, adopt new calculator distances, or establish current floatability.
